Dota 2's Behavior and Communication System Needs a Serious Rework
18 Oct @ 7:43am
13etaX
Zero responsiveness: Completely blind to pings, chat, and basic team dynamics.

3. Scripted behavior: Operating on hardcoded loops rather than actual game sense. Entire team goes missing from map they continue to farm.

Experienced players rely on contextual, real-time judgment, whereas automated systems rely on strict, non-contextual metrics.
On top of that, undeserved mass-reports from these exact bots/griefers tank behavior scores for real players. Most of the community has been here for 10+ years—we aren't kids throwing tantrums. We know the difference between a player having a bad game and a bot ruining one.

My Behavior Score and Communication Score have now dropped to critically low levels, making the overall matchmaking experience increasingly frustrating.
